# Copilot instructions for nandrespersonal

This is a personal/reference repo. Treat it carefully and do not assume it belongs in work, career, or operational workflows without explicit user intent.

When working here:

1. Ask or infer only from local repo docs before changing scope-sensitive content.
2. Avoid mixing personal material with work/career repo models unless Nick explicitly asks.
3. Keep examples synthetic, sanitized, or source-safe.
4. Do not add secrets, private source content, raw chats, customer data, incident payloads, or sensitive identifiers.
5. Do not reflect content from this repo into Career OS unless Nick explicitly frames it as career evidence.
6. Link cross-repo operating-model concepts back to `career-operating-system\00-Model\Repo-Operating-Model.md` only when relevant.
